propose_guide: Use when NL uploads a new product photo and workspace has store name, logo, or preferred style. Emit Internal social_post planning fields: title (≤20 Chinese chars ideal), caption (short XHS body with 1–3 hashtags), headline for on-image text, layout=xhs_portrait, accent/style notes. Do not publish. Next: design/template-compose (product_image_file_id + logo_file_id + headline/caption) → xiaohongshu/publish under human gate. Reuse brand voice; never invent fake discounts or medical claims.

propose_guide_i18n.en: When NL uploads a product photo with store/logo/style. Emit Internal social_post fields — do not publish. Next: template-compose → xiaohongshu/publish.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 用户上传商品图且有店名/Logo/风格时使用。产出内部 social_post 字段——不外发。下一步：模板合成→小红书。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 用戶上傳商品圖且有店名/Logo/風格時使用。產出內部 social_post 欄位——不外發。下一步：模板合成→小紅書。
